The bug has been analyzed and resolved.

### Root Cause
In [`MultiplePiePlot.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_12_group_c_fix/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/MultiplePiePlot.java#L143-L146), the constructor `MultiplePiePlot(CategoryDataset dataset)` was directly assigning `this.dataset = dataset;` instead of delegating to `setDataset(dataset);`. As a result, the plot was not registered as a `DatasetChangeListener` on the dataset, violating the requirement.

### Fix
Updated the constructor [`MultiplePiePlot(CategoryDataset dataset)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_12_group_c_fix/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/MultiplePiePlot.java#L143-L146) to call `setDataset(dataset)` instead of directly assigning `this.dataset = dataset`.

### Verification
Ran the verification test:
```bash
export TZ='America/Los_Angeles'; mvn test -Dtest=CucumberTest
```
All scenarios in [`requirement.feature`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_12_group_c_fix/requirement.feature) passed successfully. The focused patch has been saved to [`negative_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_12_group_c_fix/negative_fix.patch).
